name: Reading a Carpet Warranty Before You Buy
title-tag: Carpet Warranty Explained | Mill Creek Carpet Installation
meta-description: What a carpet warranty really covers: wear vs stain vs texture retention, the cleaning-receipt clauses that void claims, and what "lifetime" means.
post-summary: January 28, 2027 · A carpet warranty is three separate promises — wear, stain and texture retention — and most claims die on the maintenance clauses, not the coverage. What "lifetime" really means, why cleaning receipts decide claims, and why the fiber and pad you choose protect you better than any paragraph of fine print.
